channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Bucktown's Virtu Celebrating 25 Years Of Gifts, Jewelry And Joy
item.description: Julie Horowitz’s Damen Avenue boutique has evolved from a craft gallery into a shop focused on unique and often handmade items. A birthday party Saturday will feature jazz, tarot readings and more.

item.title: Madison Street Athletic And Cultural Complex Planned For East Garfield Park
item.description: The $42 million redevelopment of vacant city lots will include an indoor baseball diamond, a music studio, a cafe and an academic center.

item.title: Quantum Campus Question Won't Appear On March Ballots, Election Officials Rule
item.description: The city's elections board ruled that a referendum effort, which sought to ask whether leaders should block a South Side quantum campus and instead develop resident-led alternatives, would violate state law.

item.title: Inside Chicago Pulp, A New Bridgeport Studio Where Making Paper Takes Time
item.description: Aidan Anne Frierson and Dave King are embracing slowness, collaboration and care in a basement paper mill built for the public.

item.title: Edgewater Neighbors, Business Owners Sue The City Over Broadway Rezoning
item.description: The plaintiffs are asking for the rezoning of Broadway to be overturned, saying the city violated property owners' rights.

item.title: How Chains Are Changing Fulton Market, Once The Hot Spot For Indie Restaurants, Retailers
item.description: Raising Cane's record-setting Randolph Street lease and other chains are driving up rents and fueling fears that Fulton Market’s local character is being priced out.

item.title: Hermosa Church Building To Be Demolished For Health Clinic
item.description: PrimeCare Health plans to demolish the 55,440-square-foot building and build a two-story health clinic, which is set to open in 2027.

item.title: 18 Ways To Celebrate MLK Day With Art And Activism In Chicago
item.description: You can honor the legacy of Martin Luther King Jr. through community service, family activities and storytelling events across the city starting this week.

item.title: Wednesday Snowstorm Will Pass Quickly — But Could Pose Danger
item.description: Though the storm will only bring 1-2 inches of snow, there could be “wind gusts as high as 50 mph and visibility down to near zero in spots,” a meteorologist said.

item.title: Time Out Market To Close In Fulton Market
item.description: The food hall is closing Jan. 23 due to low and inconsistent foot traffic paired with increased operating costs, according to a statement from the parent company.
